gaps: weights: the direction of a weighted curve is the derivative of the rational curve here; X_ITE 16.6.0 ignores the weights, so for a weighted curve only this engine is checked (against the exact circle tangent)
a curve with zero derivative at the fraction (all control points equal, a stopped point) raises no event here; X_ITE normalises a zero vector (undefined)
scope: the rotation is read as the value_changed event through the SAI; two rotations compare as unit quaternions (an axis flipped with the angle negated is the same turn)
